$description: Contrast pairs that do not meet their WCAG threshold and are shipping anyway. Every entry needs a reason, a severity and an owner. scripts/test-contrast.mjs fails if a pair here starts passing, so a fix cannot leave a stale exception behind.

exceptions.reason: Hairlines and table rules are decorative separators, not UI components or meaningful graphics, so WCAG 1.4.11 does not apply. Every element they separate is identifiable without the rule.
exceptions.condition: Only valid while the rule is decorative. A border that is the sole indicator of a control's boundary must use border-brand or focus-ring instead.

exceptions.reason: Same as the light theme. Decorative separator, 1.4.11 does not apply.
exceptions.condition: Same condition as the light theme entry.

exceptions.reason: border-brand at 35% is a tint used to soften card and pill outlines. The components it borders are identified by their fill, label and position, not by the stroke.
exceptions.condition: border-brand must never be used as a focus indicator. focus-ring exists for that and measures 6.42:1. Flagged because the alias intent string in the source still says 'label pills, focus outlines'.
Same condition as the light theme entry.
